Each round of Eradication consists of two phases - the Coalition Phase and the Riot Phase. The first of these phases is the Coalition Phase. In this phase, players will be given a faction mandate. This mandate will display the groups that players have to form. For example, if there were 8 players remaining in the game, the faction mandate for the round might look something like this: YOU MUST CREATE [2] FACTIONS OF [3]
In order to be safe for this round, a player must successfully make their way into a group of three. In order to do this, each player in the group must anonymously submit this group as their faction for the round, (in your subs). If three players all submit the same group of three, then the faction is successfully created and all players within the faction are safe for the round. Players may also choose to go berserk for the round, and not submit a faction at all. This will be publicly shown, and, as a result, any player who opts to include the berserking player in their faction will see their faction fail and will be sent into the riot.
If a player is unable to successfully make it into a faction, then they will be forced to compete in the Riot Phase. This phase simply consists of a competition that all players who failed to form a faction will participate in. In the event of a duel, scores will not be shown. Whoever finishes in last place for the riot will be ERADICATED!
